title: Kyle Shanahan vaguely suggests George Kittle has "taken a step back"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan vaguely suggests George Kittle has "taken a step back"
sources.description: When 49ers tight end George Kittle recently emerged from the active/physically unable to perform list, many assumed it meant he'd be available to play in the Week 1 game against the Rams in Australia.
